title: Submit a claim with SafeTrip
summary: Explains how to file a SafeTrip travel insurance claim, the 90-day deadline, available claim forms and typical processing time.

atoms.title: How to file a SafeTrip claim in three steps
atoms.question: How do I file a SafeTrip travel insurance claim?
atoms.text: If something went wrong on a covered trip, SafeTrip says to follow three steps to get reimbursed. Step 1: find and fill out the appropriate form. Step 2: gather any documents and receipts related to the claim. Step 3: email the form and supporting documents to UHCSafeTripClaims@cbpinsure.com.

atoms.title: Deadline to submit a SafeTrip claim
atoms.question: How long do I have to submit a claim with SafeTrip?
atoms.text: A SafeTrip customer has 90 days from the date of service to submit the claim form. The date of service is the day when the customer first received treatment for a medical need or another service related to the claim.

atoms.title: SafeTrip claim forms for interruption, medical, delay and AD&D
atoms.question: Which SafeTrip claim form do I use for trip interruption, medical expense, delay or AD&D?
atoms.text: SafeTrip offers separate claim forms. The trip interruption form is for trips that were interrupted, changed or ended early, covering things like enroute meals and lodging, return fare to a home airport, pet kenneling and other non-refundable expenses. The travel medical expense form is for expenses due to injury or illness. The trip delay form covers delays outside a traveler's control, including weather delays, lost or stolen documents, unannounced strikes and natural disasters, and the AD&D form covers death or dismemberment due to an accident on the trip.

atoms.title: SafeTrip claim forms for cancellation, collision and baggage
atoms.question: Which SafeTrip claim form do I use for trip cancellation, collision damage or baggage?
atoms.text: The trip cancellation form is for unexpected cancellations before leaving home, which may be due to the injury, illness or death of someone in the group. The collision damage form is for rental car damage due to collision or any cause not in the traveler's control, and that coverage is only available as an add-on. The baggage and personal effects form is for items that are lost, delayed more than 24 hours, stolen, damaged or destroyed during the trip.

atoms.title: How long SafeTrip claims take to process
atoms.question: How long will it take for my SafeTrip claim to be processed?
atoms.text: On average, SafeTrip customers get paid 40 days after submitting their claims. Selecting the correct form helps speed processing. Customers who are unsure which form they need can call 1-877-693-8530 or email UHCSafeTripClaims@cbpinsure.com.

atoms.title: What happens after submitting a SafeTrip claim
atoms.question: What happens after I submit my SafeTrip claim?
atoms.text: After a claim form is submitted, SafeTrip says the customer should watch for communication. The customer will receive an email either asking for more documentation or updating them on the status of the claim. SafeTrip also advises checking policy documents for full details about which expenses are covered and which form to use.
